summary: MaintHeader is a maintenance screen in an ASP.NET web application, used to manage heading entries that belong to various categories. It allows administrators to view, add, edit, and delete heading records, including descriptions, notes, sort order, and alternate locale versions. The UI provides error and warning panels, a filterable grid view, and modal popups for editing details.
purpose: To provide a user interface and backend logic for managing heading/category records. Administrators can filter by category, view a list of headings, and perform CRUD operations with validations on the detail fields.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the heading entry.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Foreign key linking heading to its category.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Numeric sorting order for listing headings.

workflows.name: View Headings
steps: Grid view displays headings for selected category.

workflows.name: Add Heading
steps: Modal popup opens with empty detail fields.
User enters Description, DescriptionAlt, SortOrder, Notes, NotesAlt.
If valid, heading is added; grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Edit Heading
steps: User clicks Edit button on a grid row.
Modal popup opens with fields pre-filled.
If valid, heading is updated; grid refreshes.

workflows.name: Cancel Edit/Add
steps: Details modal closes without saving changes.

business_rules: SortOrder and Description field lengths are limited.
conditions: If CommandName equals 'cmdCancel', modal closes without update.
If CommandName is not 'cmdCancel', RefreshData and update panel.
system_behavior: Error and warning panels are visible only if messages exist.
Grid refresh triggers on category change or explicit refresh action.
Async postback triggers ensure UI updates for grid commands.
dependencies: AjaxControlToolkit for modal and UI extenders
exceptions: Invalid field values trigger validation errors.
